data: For the fiscal year ended September 27, 2025, Apple reported net sales of $416.2 billion ($416,161 million), up about 6.4% from $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Net income was $112.0 billion ($112,010 million), up about 19.5% from $93.7 billion the prior year, helped by a lower income tax provision of $20.7 billion versus $29.7 billion in fiscal 2024. Total assets stood at $359.2 billion ($359,241 million) at the end of fiscal 2025, down from $365.0 billion a year earlier, while total shareholders' equity rose to $73.7 billion from $57.0 billion.
